name: @bridge/table-ui
description: The play-table component family: PlayTable and the props-driven leaves it composes (SeatHand, SeatPlate, SeatDiagram, AuctionBox, TrickArea, ResultCard, SeatsPopup) plus the bidding pad, edge toolbar, settings menu and hand viewer. Client-only React with inline styles — mounted by both the live app and the component tester.
